### 2. Specialised Investment Fund (SIF) Regulations Grounding:
- Regulatory body: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).
- Circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-RAC-1/P/CIR/2024/168 (New Asset Class).
- Ticket size threshold: Minimum ₹10,00,000 (₹10 Lakhs) across strategies under one fund house.
- Derivative leeway: Up to 25% unhedged net derivative exposure for non-directional alpha.
- Difference from PMS: SIFs are pooled investment schemes offering daily/periodic NAVs under a mutual fund trust structure, whereas PMS requires ₹50 Lakhs minimum in individually managed segregated client demat accounts.

### 3. The 30-Year Club & Historical Compounding Grounding
- URL: `https://mfcalc.getabundance.in/pioneers`
- Dataset Scope: 29 active mutual fund schemes in India with uninterrupted operational track records exceeding 30 years (inception prior to August 1996).
- Historical Milestones:
  - UTI Mastershare Unit Scheme: Launched October 15, 1986. India's oldest surviving open-ended scheme (~40 years continuous operation).
  - Franklin India Bluechip & Franklin India Prima: Launched December 1, 1993 (originally Kothari Pioneer). First private sector schemes post-SEBI liberalization.
  - Compounding High-Water Mark: Nippon India Growth Fund delivered a 21.94% annualized CAGR from October 1995 to 2026, compounding ₹10,000 to ₹45.75 Lakhs (457.5x wealth multiplier).
  - 15-Year Rolling Risk: Empirical analysis confirms 0% historical loss probability across any 15-year or 20-year rolling investment period for diversified Indian equity funds.

### 4. India MF Geography Dataset
- URL: `https://mfcalc.getabundance.in/geography`
- Data Source: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) monthly state-wise asset reports.
- Geographic Entities Covered: All 36 Indian States and Union Territories.
- Key Metrics: Total State AUM, Equity AUM, Debt AUM, Balanced AUM, ETF AUM, FoF AUM, and State Percentage Share of National AUM.
- Regional Concentration: Maharashtra (~41%), Delhi (~10%), Gujarat (~7%), Karnataka (~7%), West Bengal (~5%). Top 5 states comprise ~70% of national mutual fund assets.

### 6. Screener, PMS & Machine-Readable Data APIs
- Mutual Fund Screener (`/screener`, JSON at `/api/screener`): Database of 2,500+ mutual fund schemes covering Equity, Hybrid, Debt, Solution-Oriented and Index schemes. Historical CAGRs (1Y, 3Y, 5Y), Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, Standard Deviation, Beta, Alpha, Portfolio Turnover, Expense Ratio and AUM. Also portfolio overlap, sector allocation, market-cap breakdown and SEBI stress-test data per scheme.
- SIF Screener (`/sifs`, JSON at `/api/sif-screener`): Every SEBI-registered Specialised Investment Fund with strategy breakdown, AUM and live NAV.
- Abundance Preferred PMS (`/pms-preferred`, JSON at `/api/pms-preferred`, Markdown at `/api/pms-preferred?format=md`): Monthly criteria-driven list of Indian PMS strategies currently Top Quartile against their APMI peer group. Fields: iaid, providerName, strategyName, category, aumCr, qualifyingPeriod, quartile, asOnMonth, factsheetAsOf, extracted (holdings / sector & market-cap allocation / portfolio ratios), plus cross-strategy insights (most-held stock, top aggregate sector, best 1-year alpha, best Sharpe). "Top Quartile" = best 25% of APMI peers for that trailing period; PMS minimum investment is ₹50,00,000 (SEBI-mandated); AUM/returns/quartile are live APMI figures while holdings are from each strategy's latest factsheet and can lag; not investment advice.
- NFO Tracker (`/nfo`, JSON at `/api/nfo`, Markdown at `/api/nfo?format=markdown`): all active, upcoming and recently closed MF and SIF New Fund Offers.
